This analysis is retained in the public repository for transparency and is not
reported in the manuscript or supplementary materials.

This report estimates the Step 3 Distress main model without Engagement Time.
Core and Peripheral strict-complete mean scores enter simultaneously at the
within-person and between-person levels. Assessment occasion and centered
linear study day are design-based nuisance adjustments at the within-person
level. The primary test is the standardized within-person Core-minus-Peripheral
slope contrast. All paths are concurrent associations, not causal effects.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
public_model_diagnostics <- function(data) {
  if ("warning_summary" %in% names(data) && !"warning_text" %in% names(data)) return(data)
  warning_text <- as.character(data$warning_text)
  stopifnot(length(warning_text) == nrow(data))
  output <- data[, setdiff(names(data), c("warning_text", "error_text")), drop = FALSE]
  output$warning_summary <- ifelse(
    grepl("following clusters|cluster IDs", warning_text, ignore.case = TRUE),
    "Includes a within-cluster variation warning; individual details remain private",
    ifelse(nzchar(warning_text), "Other warning; details retained locally", "None")
  )
  output
}

locate_project_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  current <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  if (!dir.exists(current)) current <- dirname(current)
  repeat {
    if (all(dir.exists(file.path(current, c(
      "Step_1_Descriptive_and_Reliability",
      "Step_3_Concurrent_Multilevel_Associations"
    ))))) return(current)
    parent <- dirname(current)
    if (identical(parent, current)) break
    current <- parent
  }
  stop("Could not locate the project from its public Step directories")
}

load_single_object <- function(path, expected_name) {
  environment <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
  loaded <- load(path, envir = environment)
  if (!identical(loaded, expected_name)) {
    stop(
      "Expected only ", expected_name, " in ", path,
      "; found: ", paste(loaded, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  environment[[expected_name]]
}

mplus_numeric <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(x)))

summary_value <- function(summary_row, candidates, type = c("numeric", "character")) {
  type <- match.arg(type)
  hit <- intersect(candidates, names(summary_row))
  if (!length(hit)) return(if (type == "numeric") NA_real_ else NA_character_)
  value <- summary_row[[hit[[1L]]]][[1L]]
  if (type == "numeric") mplus_numeric(value) else as.character(value)
}

flatten_messages <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || !length(x)) return("")
  paste(unlist(x, recursive = TRUE, use.names = FALSE), collapse = " | ")
}

parse_output_integer <- function(path, label) {
  lines <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE)
  hit <- grep(label, lines, ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE, fixed = TRUE)
  if (!length(hit)) return(NA_integer_)
  numbers <- regmatches(hit[[1L]], gregexpr("[0-9]+", hit[[1L]]))[[1L]]
  if (!length(numbers)) NA_integer_ else as.integer(tail(numbers, 1L))
}

round_numeric_columns <- function(data, digits = 4L) {
  data |>
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, digits)))
}

vif_table <- function(data, variables, level_label, model_label) {
  x <- as.data.frame(data[stats::complete.cases(data[variables]), variables, drop = FALSE])
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(variables, function(target) {
    others <- setdiff(variables, target)
    fit <- stats::lm(stats::reformulate(others, response = target), data = x)
    r_squared <- summary(fit)$r.squared
    data.frame(
      model = model_label, level = level_label, variable = target,
      r_squared_from_other_predictors = r_squared,
      vif = 1 / (1 - r_squared), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }))
}

condition_index <- function(data, variables) {
  x <- data[stats::complete.cases(data[variables]), variables, drop = FALSE]
  correlation <- stats::cor(x)
  eigenvalues <- eigen(correlation, symmetric = TRUE, only.values = TRUE)$values
  sqrt(max(eigenvalues) / min(eigenvalues))
}

skewness <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) < 3L || stats::sd(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  mean((x - mean(x))^3) / stats::sd(x)^3
}

excess_kurtosis <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) < 4L || stats::sd(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  mean((x - mean(x))^4) / stats::sd(x)^4 - 3
}

style_and_sanitize_workbook <- function(path, sheet_data) {
  workbook <- openxlsx::loadWorkbook(path)
  header_style <- openxlsx::createStyle(
    fontName = "Aptos", fontSize = 10, textDecoration = "bold",
    fontColour = "#FFFFFF", fgFill = "#1F4E78",
    halign = "center", valign = "center", wrapText = TRUE,
    border = "bottom", borderColour = "#163A5C"
  )
  body_style <- openxlsx::createStyle(
    fontName = "Aptos", fontSize = 10, valign = "top", wrapText = TRUE
  )
  integer_style <- openxlsx::createStyle(numFmt = "0")
  decimal_style <- openxlsx::createStyle(numFmt = "0.0000")

  for (sheet_name in names(sheet_data)) {
    data <- sheet_data[[sheet_name]]
    row_count <- nrow(data) + 1L
    column_count <- ncol(data)
    openxlsx::showGridLines(workbook, sheet = sheet_name, showGridLines = FALSE)
    openxlsx::freezePane(workbook, sheet = sheet_name, firstRow = TRUE)
    openxlsx::setRowHeights(workbook, sheet = sheet_name, rows = 1L, heights = 30)
    openxlsx::addStyle(
      workbook, sheet = sheet_name, style = header_style,
      rows = 1L, cols = seq_len(column_count), gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE
    )
    if (row_count > 1L) {
      openxlsx::addStyle(
        workbook, sheet = sheet_name, style = body_style,
        rows = 2L:row_count, cols = seq_len(column_count),
        gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE
      )
    }
    integer_columns <- which(
      vapply(data, is.integer, logical(1)) |
        names(data) %in% c(
          "observations", "clusters", "free_parameters", "df", "errors_n",
          "warnings_n", "required_paths", "required_contrasts", "n",
          "rank", "cluster_id", "endpoint_300_count", "n_observed"
        )
    )
    numeric_columns <- setdiff(which(vapply(data, is.numeric, logical(1))), integer_columns)
    if (row_count > 1L && length(integer_columns)) {
      openxlsx::addStyle(
        workbook, sheet = sheet_name, style = integer_style,
        rows = 2L:row_count, cols = integer_columns,
        gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE
      )
    }
    if (row_count > 1L && length(numeric_columns)) {
      openxlsx::addStyle(
        workbook, sheet = sheet_name, style = decimal_style,
        rows = 2L:row_count, cols = numeric_columns,
        gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE
      )
    }
    column_widths <- vapply(seq_len(column_count), function(column_index) {
      values <- c(names(data)[column_index], as.character(data[[column_index]]))
      values[is.na(values)] <- ""
      max_width <- max(nchar(values, type = "width"), na.rm = TRUE) + 2L
      min(42, max(11, max_width))
    }, numeric(1))
    openxlsx::setColWidths(
      workbook, sheet = sheet_name, cols = seq_len(column_count),
      widths = column_widths
    )
  }

  workbook$worksheets_rels <- lapply(
    workbook$worksheets_rels,
    function(x) x[grepl("printerSettings", x, fixed = TRUE)]
  )
  workbook$Content_Types <- workbook$Content_Types[
    !grepl("/xl/drawings/", workbook$Content_Types, fixed = TRUE)
  ]
  openxlsx::saveWorkbook(workbook, path, overwrite = TRUE)
  invisible(path)
}
```

```{r load-saved-results, include=FALSE, eval=use_saved_results}
load_saved_display <- function(path, input_path) {
  saved <- load_single_object(path, "fit_s3_3_unadjusted_distress")
  stopifnot(is.list(saved), is.list(saved$metadata))
  metadata <- saved$metadata
  stopifnot(
    identical(metadata$input_md5, unname(tools::md5sum(input_path))),
    isTRUE(metadata$observations == 17755L), isTRUE(metadata$clusters == 209L),
    identical(metadata$estimator, "MLR"),
    length(metadata$mplus_version) == 1L,
    metadata$mplus_version %in% c("8.7", "9")
  )
  fields <- c("variable_map", "model_fit", "raw_paths", "standardized_paths", "standardized_contrasts", "r_squared", "diagnostics", "predictor_correlations", "linearity_bins", "residual_diagnostics", "duration_context", "diagnostic_flags")
  stopifnot(all(fields %in% names(saved)))
  tables <- saved[fields]
  predictor <- saved$predictor_diagnostics
  stopifnot(is.data.frame(predictor), all(c("model", "level", "diagnostic_type",
    "variable", "r_squared_from_other_predictors", "vif", "condition_index") %in% names(predictor)))
  tables$vif_diagnostics <- predictor[predictor$diagnostic_type == "VIF",
    c("model", "level", "variable", "r_squared_from_other_predictors", "vif"), drop = FALSE]
  tables$condition_diagnostics <- predictor[predictor$diagnostic_type == "Condition index",
    c("model", "level", "condition_index"), drop = FALSE]
  influence <- saved$influence_diagnostics
  stopifnot(is.data.frame(influence),
    all(c("level", "maximum_absolute_change") %in% names(influence)),
    all(is.finite(influence$maximum_absolute_change)))
  tables$influence_public_summary <- influence |>
    dplyr::group_by(level) |>
    dplyr::summarise(maximum_absolute_change = max(maximum_absolute_change), .groups = "drop")
  # Raw message text can contain individual cluster identifiers.
  tables$diagnostics <- public_model_diagnostics(tables$diagnostics)
  expected_rows <- c(variable_map = 20L, model_fit = 2L, raw_paths = 4L, standardized_paths = 4L, standardized_contrasts = 2L, r_squared = 4L, diagnostics = 2L, predictor_correlations = 11L, linearity_bins = 20L, residual_diagnostics = 2L, duration_context = 3L, diagnostic_flags = 5L, vif_diagnostics = 9L, condition_diagnostics = 3L, influence_public_summary = 2L)
  stopifnot(setequal(names(tables), names(expected_rows)))
  required_columns <- list(
    variable_map = c("representation", "mplus_variable", "project_variable"),
    model_fit = c("model_id", "representation", "mplus_version", "estimator", "observations", "clusters", "free_parameters", "scaled_chi_square", "scaling_correction", "df", "p_value", "cfi", "tli", "rmsea", "srmr_within", "srmr_between", "loglikelihood", "aic", "bic", "adjusted_bic"),
    raw_paths = c("model_id", "representation", "scale", "level", "outcome", "predictor", "estimate", "se", "z", "p_value", "ci_lower", "ci_upper"),
    standardized_paths = c("model_id", "representation", "scale", "level", "outcome", "predictor", "estimate", "se", "z", "p_value", "ci_lower", "ci_upper"),
    standardized_contrasts = c("model_id", "representation", "scale", "level", "contrast", "estimate", "se", "z", "p_value", "ci_lower", "ci_upper"),
    r_squared = c("model_id", "representation", "level", "outcome", "r_squared"),
    diagnostics = c("model_id", "representation", "normal_termination", "errors_n", "warnings_n", "minimum_residual_variance", "residual_variances_positive", "required_paths", "required_contrasts", "expected_paths_present", "expected_contrasts_present", "technical_pass", "warning_summary"),
    predictor_correlations = c("model", "level", "variable_1", "variable_2", "correlation"),
    linearity_bins = c("bin", "level", "predictor", "n", "mean_partial_predictor", "mean_partial_distress"),
    residual_diagnostics = c("level", "n", "mean", "sd", "rmse", "skewness", "excess_kurtosis", "minimum", "maximum", "maximum_absolute"),
    duration_context = c("variable", "behavior", "n_observed", "mean_minutes", "sd_minutes", "median_minutes", "minimum", "maximum", "zero_percent", "endpoint_300_count", "skewness", "excess_kurtosis"),
    diagnostic_flags = c("diagnostic", "flagged"),
    vif_diagnostics = c("model", "level", "variable", "r_squared_from_other_predictors", "vif"),
    condition_diagnostics = c("model", "level", "condition_index"),
    influence_public_summary = c("level", "maximum_absolute_change")
  )
  for (name in names(tables)) {
    table <- tables[[name]]
    stopifnot(is.data.frame(table), nrow(table) == expected_rows[[name]],
      identical(names(table), required_columns[[name]]),
      !anyDuplicated(names(table)),
      !any(grepl("^(Name_ID|Data_ID|cluster_id|rank|warning_text|error_text)$",
                 names(table), ignore.case = TRUE)))
  }
  stopifnot(
    nrow(tables$model_fit) == 2L,
    all(tables$model_fit$observations == metadata$observations),
    all(tables$model_fit$clusters == metadata$clusters),
    all(tables$model_fit$estimator == metadata$estimator),
    all(tables$model_fit$mplus_version == metadata$mplus_version),
    length(tables$diagnostics$technical_pass) == 2L,
    all(tables$diagnostics$technical_pass),
    all(tables$r_squared$r_squared >= 0 & tables$r_squared$r_squared <= 1),
    file.exists(figure_file)
  )
  tables
}
```

# Construct raw and level-standardized Mplus data

The raw representation preserves the 1--5 mean-score units. The companion
representation uses the S3.1 level-specific z scores so that the
Core-minus-Peripheral contrast is directly interpretable on a common scale.

```{r prepare-mplus-data, eval=!use_saved_results}
raw_map <- c(
  id = "Name_ID", dayc = "Day_c", tm2 = "Time_2", tm3 = "Time_3",
  disw = "Distress_W", corew = "Core_W", periw = "Peripheral_W",
  disb = "Distress_B", coreb = "Core_B", perib = "Peripheral_B"
)
standardized_map <- c(
  id = "Name_ID", dayc = "Day_c", tm2 = "Time_2", tm3 = "Time_3",
  diswz = "Distress_W_Z", corewz = "Core_W_Z", periwz = "Peripheral_W_Z",
  disbz = "Distress_B_Z", corebz = "Core_B_Z", peribz = "Peripheral_B_Z"
)

make_mplus_data <- function(map) {
  output <- dat_s33[unname(map)]
  names(output) <- names(map)
  output$id <- as.integer(factor(output$id, levels = sort(unique(output$id))))
  stopifnot(!anyNA(output), nrow(output) == expected_observations)
  as.data.frame(output)
}

mplus_data_raw <- make_mplus_data(raw_map)
mplus_data_standardized <- make_mplus_data(standardized_map)
variable_map <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  data.frame(
    representation = "Raw", mplus_variable = names(raw_map),
    project_variable = unname(raw_map), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ),
  data.frame(
    representation = "Level-standardized",
    mplus_variable = names(standardized_map),
    project_variable = unname(standardized_map), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
)
```

# Define and run the Mplus models

```{r run-mplus-models, eval=!use_saved_results}
model_specifications <- list(
  raw = list(
    id = "S3_3_RAW",
    label = "Raw strict-complete mean scores",
    stem = "s3_3_unadjusted_distress_raw",
    data = mplus_data_raw,
    usevariables = names(raw_map),
    variable = paste(
      "CLUSTER = id;",
      "WITHIN = disw corew periw dayc tm2 tm3;",
      "BETWEEN = disb coreb perib;",
      sep = "\n"
    ),
    model = paste(
      "%WITHIN%",
      "disw ON corew (wc);",
      "disw ON periw (wp);",
      "disw ON dayc;",
      "disw ON tm2;",
      "disw ON tm3;",
      "%BETWEEN%",
      "disb ON coreb (bc);",
      "disb ON perib (bp);",
      sep = "\n"
    )
  ),
  standardized = list(
    id = "S3_3_STD",
    label = "Level-standardized focal model",
    stem = "s3_3_unadjusted_distress_standardized",
    data = mplus_data_standardized,
    usevariables = names(standardized_map),
    variable = paste(
      "CLUSTER = id;",
      "WITHIN = diswz corewz periwz dayc tm2 tm3;",
      "BETWEEN = disbz corebz peribz;",
      sep = "\n"
    ),
    model = paste(
      "%WITHIN%",
      "diswz ON corewz (wc);",
      "diswz ON periwz (wp);",
      "diswz ON dayc;",
      "diswz ON tm2;",
      "diswz ON tm3;",
      "%BETWEEN%",
      "disbz ON corebz (bc);",
      "disbz ON peribz (bp);",
      sep = "\n"
    )
  )
)

model_constraint <- paste(
  "NEW(wdiff bdiff);",
  "wdiff = wc - wp;",
  "bdiff = bc - bp;",
  sep = "\n"
)

run_mplus_model <- function(specification) {
  data_path <- file.path(mplus_directory, paste0(specification$stem, ".dat"))
  input_path <- file.path(mplus_directory, paste0(specification$stem, ".inp"))
  output_path <- file.path(mplus_directory, paste0(specification$stem, ".out"))

  mplus_object <- MplusAutomation::mplusObject(
    TITLE = paste(
      "! Author: Kunru Song",
      "! Step 3.3 Distress model without Engagement Time.",
      "! Concurrent association; Time and Day are within-level design controls.",
      specification$label,
      sep = "\n"
    ),
    VARIABLE = specification$variable,
    ANALYSIS = paste("TYPE = TWOLEVEL;", "ESTIMATOR = MLR;", sep = "\n"),
    MODEL = specification$model,
    MODELCONSTRAINT = model_constraint,
    OUTPUT = paste(
      "SAMPSTAT;", "STANDARDIZED(STDYX);", "CINTERVAL;",
      "RESIDUAL;", "TECH1;", "TECH4;", sep = "\n"
    ),
    usevariables = specification$usevariables,
    rdata = specification$data,
    autov = FALSE,
    quiet = TRUE
  )

  modeler_result <- MplusAutomation::mplusModeler(
    object = mplus_object,
    dataout = data_path,
    modelout = input_path,
    run = 1L,
    check = FALSE,
    varwarnings = TRUE,
    Mplus_command = mplus_command,
    writeData = "always",
    hashfilename = FALSE,
    killOnFail = TRUE,
    quiet = TRUE
  )

  stopifnot(file.exists(data_path), file.exists(input_path), file.exists(output_path))
  input_lines <- readLines(input_path, warn = FALSE)
  output_lines <- readLines(output_path, warn = FALSE)
  parsed <- MplusAutomation::readModels(output_path, what = "all", quiet = TRUE)
  checks <- list(
    author_present = any(trimws(input_lines) == "! Author: Kunru Song"),
    missing_declared = any(grepl(
      "MISSING\\s*=\\s*\\.;", input_lines, ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE
    )),
    twolevel_declared = any(grepl(
      "TYPE\\s*=\\s*TWOLEVEL;", input_lines, ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE
    )),
    mlr_declared = any(grepl(
      "ESTIMATOR\\s*=\\s*MLR;", input_lines, ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE
    )),
    cluster_declared = any(grepl(
      "CLUSTER\\s*=\\s*id;", input_lines, ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE
    )),
    constraint_declared = any(grepl(
      "MODEL CONSTRAINT", input_lines, ignore.case = TRUE, fixed = TRUE
    )),
    normal_termination = any(grepl(
      "THE MODEL ESTIMATION TERMINATED NORMALLY", output_lines, fixed = TRUE
    )),
    no_engagement_variables = !any(grepl(
      "intw|actw|pasw|intb|actb|pasb", input_lines,
      ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE
    ))
  )
  summary_row <- parsed$summaries[1, , drop = FALSE]
  checks$mplus_8_7 <- identical(
    summary_value(summary_row, "Mplus.version", "character"), "8.7"
  )
  checks$estimator_mlr <- identical(
    summary_value(summary_row, "Estimator", "character"), "MLR"
  )
  checks$observations_match <-
    as.integer(summary_value(summary_row, "Observations", "numeric")) ==
      expected_observations
  checks$clusters_match <-
    parse_output_integer(output_path, "Number of clusters") == expected_clusters
  stopifnot(all(unlist(checks)))

  list(
    model_id = specification$id,
    model_label = specification$label,
    syntax = list(
      variable = specification$variable,
      model = specification$model,
      constraint = model_constraint
    ),
    paths = list(data = data_path, input = input_path, output = output_path),
    file_md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(c(data_path, input_path, output_path))),
    checks = checks,
    parsed = parsed,
    modeler_result = modeler_result,
    warnings = flatten_messages(parsed$warnings),
    errors = flatten_messages(parsed$errors)
  )
}

model_runs <- lapply(model_specifications, run_mplus_model)
```

# Extract fit, focal paths, direct contrasts, and R-squared

Full warning/error text is kept in the local result object because it can contain
individual cluster identifiers. The public table retains warning/error flags and
an aggregate warning description. Fit indices for saturated models (df = 0) are
not interpreted.

```{r extract-results, eval=!use_saved_results}
extract_fit <- function(run) {
  s <- run$parsed$summaries[1, , drop = FALSE]
  data.frame(
    model_id = run$model_id,
    representation = run$model_label,
    mplus_version = summary_value(s, "Mplus.version", "character"),
    estimator = summary_value(s, "Estimator", "character"),
    observations = summary_value(s, "Observations", "numeric"),
    clusters = parse_output_integer(run$paths$output, "Number of clusters"),
    free_parameters = summary_value(s, "Parameters", "numeric"),
    scaled_chi_square = summary_value(s, "ChiSqM_Value", "numeric"),
    scaling_correction = summary_value(s, "ChiSqM_ScalingCorrection", "numeric"),
    df = summary_value(s, "ChiSqM_DF", "numeric"),
    p_value = summary_value(s, "ChiSqM_PValue", "numeric"),
    cfi = summary_value(s, "CFI", "numeric"),
    tli = summary_value(s, "TLI", "numeric"),
    rmsea = summary_value(s, "RMSEA_Estimate", "numeric"),
    srmr_within = summary_value(
      s, c("SRMR.Within", "SRMR_Within", "SRMRWithin"), "numeric"
    ),
    srmr_between = summary_value(
      s, c("SRMR.Between", "SRMR_Between", "SRMRBetween"), "numeric"
    ),
    loglikelihood = summary_value(s, "LL", "numeric"),
    aic = summary_value(s, "AIC", "numeric"),
    bic = summary_value(s, "BIC", "numeric"),
    adjusted_bic = summary_value(s, "aBIC", "numeric"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

outcome_dictionary <- c(
  DISW = "Distress", DISB = "Distress",
  DISWZ = "Distress", DISBZ = "Distress"
)
predictor_dictionary <- c(
  COREW = "Core", PERIW = "Peripheral", COREB = "Core", PERIB = "Peripheral",
  COREWZ = "Core", PERIWZ = "Peripheral",
  COREBZ = "Core", PERIBZ = "Peripheral"
)

extract_paths <- function(run) {
  parameters <- run$parsed$parameters$unstandardized |>
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(
      dplyr::any_of(c("est", "se", "est_se", "pval")), mplus_numeric
    ))
  ci <- run$parsed$parameters$ci.unstandardized
  if (!is.null(ci) && nrow(ci)) {
    ci <- ci |>
      dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(
        dplyr::any_of(c("low2.5", "up2.5")), mplus_numeric
      )) |>
      dplyr::select(dplyr::any_of(c(
        "paramHeader", "param", "BetweenWithin", "low2.5", "up2.5"
      )))
  }
  paths <- parameters |>
    dplyr::filter(grepl("\\.ON$", paramHeader)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      outcome_code = sub("\\.ON$", "", paramHeader),
      predictor_code = param,
      outcome = unname(outcome_dictionary[outcome_code]),
      predictor = unname(predictor_dictionary[predictor_code])
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(outcome), !is.na(predictor)) |>
    dplyr::select(
      paramHeader, param, BetweenWithin, outcome_code, outcome, predictor,
      estimate = est, se, z = est_se, p_value = pval
    )
  if (!is.null(ci) && nrow(ci)) {
    paths <- paths |>
      dplyr::left_join(ci, by = c("paramHeader", "param", "BetweenWithin")) |>
      dplyr::rename(ci_lower = low2.5, ci_upper = up2.5)
  } else {
    paths$ci_lower <- paths$estimate - 1.96 * paths$se
    paths$ci_upper <- paths$estimate + 1.96 * paths$se
  }
  paths |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      model_id = run$model_id,
      representation = run$model_label,
      level = ifelse(grepl("B$|BZ$", outcome_code), "Between", "Within"),
      scale = ifelse(grepl("Z$", outcome_code), "Standardized", "Raw")
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(
      model_id, representation, scale, level, outcome, predictor,
      estimate, se, z, p_value, ci_lower, ci_upper
    )
}

contrast_dictionary <- data.frame(
  param = c("WDIFF", "BDIFF"),
  level = c("Within", "Between"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

extract_contrasts <- function(run) {
  run$parsed$parameters$unstandardized |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      dplyr::across(
        dplyr::any_of(c("est", "se", "est_se", "pval")), mplus_numeric
      ),
      param_upper = toupper(param)
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(param_upper %in% contrast_dictionary$param) |>
    dplyr::left_join(contrast_dictionary, by = c("param_upper" = "param")) |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      model_id = run$model_id,
      representation = run$model_label,
      scale = ifelse(run$model_id == "S3_3_STD", "Standardized", "Raw"),
      level,
      contrast = "Core slope - Peripheral slope",
      estimate = est, se, z = est_se, p_value = pval,
      ci_lower = est - 1.96 * se,
      ci_upper = est + 1.96 * se
    )
}

extract_r2 <- function(run) {
  r2 <- run$parsed$parameters$r2
  if (is.null(r2) || !nrow(r2)) return(data.frame())
  r2 |>
    dplyr::mutate(est = mplus_numeric(est), param_upper = toupper(param)) |>
    dplyr::filter(param_upper %in% names(outcome_dictionary)) |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      model_id = run$model_id,
      representation = run$model_label,
      level = ifelse(grepl("B$|BZ$", param_upper), "Between", "Within"),
      outcome = "Distress", r_squared = est
    )
}

model_fit <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(model_runs, extract_fit))
paths <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(model_runs, extract_paths))
contrasts <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(model_runs, extract_contrasts))
r_squared <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(model_runs, extract_r2))

diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(model_runs, function(run) {
  residuals <- run$parsed$parameters$unstandardized |>
    dplyr::mutate(est = mplus_numeric(est)) |>
    dplyr::filter(paramHeader == "Residual.Variances")
  data.frame(
    model_id = run$model_id,
    representation = run$model_label,
    normal_termination = run$checks$normal_termination,
    errors_n = ifelse(nzchar(run$errors), 1L, 0L),
    warnings_n = ifelse(nzchar(run$warnings), 1L, 0L),
    minimum_residual_variance = if (nrow(residuals)) min(residuals$est) else NA_real_,
    residual_variances_positive = if (nrow(residuals)) all(residuals$est > 0) else FALSE,
    required_paths = sum(paths$model_id == run$model_id),
    required_contrasts = sum(contrasts$model_id == run$model_id),
    warning_text = run$warnings,
    error_text = ifelse(nzchar(run$errors), run$errors, "None"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    expected_paths_present = required_paths == 4L,
    expected_contrasts_present = required_contrasts == 2L,
    technical_pass = normal_termination & errors_n == 0L &
      residual_variances_positive & expected_paths_present &
      expected_contrasts_present
  )

raw_paths <- paths |> dplyr::filter(model_id == "S3_3_RAW")
standardized_paths <- paths |> dplyr::filter(model_id == "S3_3_STD")
standardized_contrasts <- contrasts |> dplyr::filter(model_id == "S3_3_STD")
sign_agreement <- raw_paths |>
  dplyr::select(level, predictor, raw_estimate = estimate) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    standardized_paths |>
      dplyr::select(level, predictor, standardized_estimate = estimate),
    by = c("level", "predictor")
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(sign_agrees = sign(raw_estimate) == sign(standardized_estimate))

stopifnot(
  nrow(model_fit) == 2L,
  nrow(raw_paths) == 4L,
  nrow(standardized_paths) == 4L,
  nrow(contrasts) == 4L,
  nrow(standardized_contrasts) == 2L,
  all(diagnostics$technical_pass),
  all(sign_agreement$sign_agrees),
  nrow(r_squared) == 4L,
  all(r_squared$r_squared >= 0 & r_squared$r_squared <= 1)
)
```

# Predictor, linearity, residual, and influence diagnostics

The diagnostic regressions below are R screening companions to the canonical
Mplus estimates. They use the identical fixed sample and structural predictors
to inspect multicollinearity, partial linearity, residual shape, and sensitivity
to individual clusters. They do not replace Mplus inference and do not delete
participants automatically.

Cluster-specific influence records remain in the local result object and
workbook. The public report shows only the largest absolute Core/Peripheral
coefficient change at each level, without participant identifiers or rankings.

```{r diagnostic-audit, eval=!use_saved_results}
between_data <- dat_s33 |>
  dplyr::select(Name_ID, Distress_B, Core_B, Peripheral_B,
    Distress_B_Z, Core_B_Z, Peripheral_B_Z) |>
  dplyr::distinct() |>
  as.data.frame()
stopifnot(nrow(between_data) == expected_clusters)

within_focus <- c("Core_W", "Peripheral_W")
within_design <- c("Core_W", "Peripheral_W", "Day_c", "Time_2", "Time_3")
between_focus <- c("Core_B", "Peripheral_B")

vif_diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  vif_table(dat_s33, within_focus, "Within", "S3.3 focal predictors"),
  vif_table(dat_s33, within_design, "Within", "S3.3 including Time/Day"),
  vif_table(between_data, between_focus, "Between", "S3.3 focal predictors")
)
condition_diagnostics <- data.frame(
  model = c(
    "S3.3 focal predictors", "S3.3 including Time/Day",
    "S3.3 focal predictors"
  ),
  level = c("Within", "Within", "Between"),
  condition_index = c(
    condition_index(dat_s33, within_focus),
    condition_index(dat_s33, within_design),
    condition_index(between_data, between_focus)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

correlation_pairs <- function(data, variables, level_label, model_label) {
  matrix <- stats::cor(data[variables], use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  indices <- which(upper.tri(matrix), arr.ind = TRUE)
  data.frame(
    model = model_label, level = level_label,
    variable_1 = rownames(matrix)[indices[, 1]],
    variable_2 = colnames(matrix)[indices[, 2]],
    correlation = matrix[indices], stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
predictor_correlations <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  correlation_pairs(dat_s33, within_design, "Within", "S3.3 including Time/Day"),
  correlation_pairs(between_data, between_focus, "Between", "S3.3 focal predictors")
)

partial_binned_summary <- function(data, focal, adjustment, label, level_label) {
  outcome_residual <- stats::resid(stats::lm(
    stats::reformulate(adjustment, response = "Distress_W_Z"), data = data
  ))
  predictor_residual <- stats::resid(stats::lm(
    stats::reformulate(adjustment, response = focal), data = data
  ))
  data.frame(
    partial_predictor = predictor_residual,
    partial_distress = outcome_residual
  ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(bin = dplyr::ntile(partial_predictor, 10L)) |>
    dplyr::group_by(bin) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      level = .env$level_label,
      predictor = .env$label,
      n = dplyr::n(),
      mean_partial_predictor = mean(partial_predictor),
      mean_partial_distress = mean(partial_distress),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}
linearity_bins <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  partial_binned_summary(
    dat_s33, "Core_W_Z",
    c("Peripheral_W_Z", "Day_c", "Time_2", "Time_3"),
    "Core", "Within"
  ),
  partial_binned_summary(
    dat_s33, "Peripheral_W_Z",
    c("Core_W_Z", "Day_c", "Time_2", "Time_3"),
    "Peripheral", "Within"
  )
)

within_screen <- stats::lm(
  Distress_W ~ Core_W + Peripheral_W + Day_c + Time_2 + Time_3,
  data = dat_s33
)
between_screen <- stats::lm(
  Distress_B ~ Core_B + Peripheral_B, data = between_data
)
residual_diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(
  list(Within = stats::resid(within_screen), Between = stats::resid(between_screen)),
  function(residual) {
    data.frame(
      n = length(residual), mean = mean(residual), sd = stats::sd(residual),
      rmse = sqrt(mean(residual^2)), skewness = skewness(residual),
      excess_kurtosis = excess_kurtosis(residual),
      minimum = min(residual), maximum = max(residual),
      maximum_absolute = max(abs(residual)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
), .id = "level")

within_screen_z <- stats::lm(
  Distress_W_Z ~ Core_W_Z + Peripheral_W_Z + Day_c + Time_2 + Time_3,
  data = dat_s33
)
between_screen_z <- stats::lm(
  Distress_B_Z ~ Core_B_Z + Peripheral_B_Z, data = between_data
)
within_reference <- stats::coef(within_screen_z)[c("Core_W_Z", "Peripheral_W_Z")]
between_reference <- stats::coef(between_screen_z)[c("Core_B_Z", "Peripheral_B_Z")]

within_leave_one_cluster <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(unique(dat_s33$Name_ID), function(id) {
  fit <- stats::lm(
    Distress_W_Z ~ Core_W_Z + Peripheral_W_Z + Day_c + Time_2 + Time_3,
    data = dat_s33[dat_s33$Name_ID != id, ]
  )
  coefficient <- stats::coef(fit)[c("Core_W_Z", "Peripheral_W_Z")]
  data.frame(
    level = "Within", cluster_id = as.character(id),
    core_change = coefficient[[1L]] - within_reference[[1L]],
    peripheral_change = coefficient[[2L]] - within_reference[[2L]],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))
between_leave_one_cluster <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(unique(between_data$Name_ID), function(id) {
  fit <- stats::lm(
    Distress_B_Z ~ Core_B_Z + Peripheral_B_Z,
    data = between_data[between_data$Name_ID != id, ]
  )
  coefficient <- stats::coef(fit)[c("Core_B_Z", "Peripheral_B_Z")]
  data.frame(
    level = "Between", cluster_id = as.character(id),
    core_change = coefficient[[1L]] - between_reference[[1L]],
    peripheral_change = coefficient[[2L]] - between_reference[[2L]],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))
influence_diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  within_leave_one_cluster, between_leave_one_cluster
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    maximum_absolute_change = pmax(abs(core_change), abs(peripheral_change))
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(level) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(maximum_absolute_change), .by_group = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(rank = dplyr::row_number()) |>
  dplyr::filter(rank <= 10L) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::select(
    level, rank, cluster_id, core_change,
    peripheral_change, maximum_absolute_change
  )

duration_context <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(
  names(c(
    InteractiveTime = "Interactive/message",
    ActiveTime = "Active/posting",
    PassiveTime = "Passive/browsing"
  )),
  function(variable) {
    label <- c(
      InteractiveTime = "Interactive/message",
      ActiveTime = "Active/posting",
      PassiveTime = "Passive/browsing"
    )[[variable]]
    x <- dat_s33[[variable]]
    data.frame(
      variable = variable, behavior = label, n_observed = length(x),
      mean_minutes = mean(x), sd_minutes = stats::sd(x),
      median_minutes = stats::median(x), minimum = min(x), maximum = max(x),
      zero_percent = mean(x == 0) * 100,
      endpoint_300_count = sum(x == 300),
      skewness = skewness(x), excess_kurtosis = excess_kurtosis(x),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
))

diagnostic_flags <- data.frame(
  diagnostic = c(
    "Maximum VIF exceeds 5",
    "Maximum condition index exceeds 30",
    "Posting zero percentage differs materially from verified context",
    "Duration value outside 0-300",
    "Influence diagnostic contains non-finite change"
  ),
  flagged = c(
    max(vif_diagnostics$vif) > 5,
    max(condition_diagnostics$condition_index) > 30,
    abs(duration_context$zero_percent[duration_context$variable == "ActiveTime"] -
      75.13) > 0.10,
    any(duration_context$minimum < 0 | duration_context$maximum > 300),
    any(!is.finite(influence_diagnostics$maximum_absolute_change))
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
stopifnot(!any(diagnostic_flags$flagged))

influence_public_summary <- influence_diagnostics |>
  dplyr::group_by(level) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    maximum_absolute_change = max(maximum_absolute_change), .groups = "drop"
  )
```

# Figure

```{r export-results, include=FALSE, eval=!use_saved_results}
plot_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  standardized_paths |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      level, term = predictor, estimate, se, p_value, ci_lower, ci_upper,
      estimate_type = "Simultaneous path"
    ),
  standardized_contrasts |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      level, term = "Core - Peripheral", estimate, se, p_value,
      ci_lower, ci_upper, estimate_type = "Direct contrast"
    )
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    term = factor(term, levels = c("Core", "Peripheral", "Core - Peripheral")),
    level = factor(level, levels = c("Within", "Between"))
  )

coefficient_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  plot_data,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x = term, y = estimate, ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper,
    color = estimate_type
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  ggplot2::geom_pointrange(linewidth = 0.45) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ level, scales = "free_y") +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Simultaneous path" = "#2C7FB8", "Direct contrast" = "#D95F0E")
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Standardized concurrent coefficient",
    color = NULL,
    title = "Core and Peripheral associations with Distress",
    subtitle = paste(
      "S3.3 model without Engagement Time; points are Mplus MLR estimates",
      "with 95% confidence intervals"
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    plot.title.position = "plot"
  )

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = figure_file, plot = coefficient_plot,
  device = svglite::svglite, width = 9, height = 5.5, bg = "white"
)

predictor_diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  vif_diagnostics |>
    dplyr::mutate(condition_index = NA_real_, diagnostic_type = "VIF"),
  condition_diagnostics |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      variable = "Overall condition index",
      r_squared_from_other_predictors = NA_real_, vif = NA_real_,
      diagnostic_type = "Condition index"
    )
) |>
  dplyr::select(
    model, level, diagnostic_type, variable,
    r_squared_from_other_predictors, vif, condition_index
  )

workbook_sheets <- list(
  Model_Fit = round_numeric_columns(model_fit),
  Raw_Paths = round_numeric_columns(raw_paths),
  Standardized_Paths = round_numeric_columns(standardized_paths),
  Standardized_Contrasts = round_numeric_columns(standardized_contrasts),

  Predictor_Diagnostics = round_numeric_columns(predictor_diagnostics),
  Predictor_Correlations = round_numeric_columns(predictor_correlations),
  Linearity_Bins = round_numeric_columns(linearity_bins),
  Residual_Diagnostics = round_numeric_columns(residual_diagnostics),
  Influence_Diagnostics = round_numeric_columns(influence_diagnostics),
  Duration_Context = round_numeric_columns(duration_context)
)

bruceR::export(workbook_sheets, file = table_file, overwrite = TRUE)
style_and_sanitize_workbook(table_file, workbook_sheets)

fit_s3_3_unadjusted_distress <- list(
```

```{r final-validation, include=FALSE, eval=!use_saved_results}
verified_result <- load_single_object(
  result_file, "fit_s3_3_unadjusted_distress"
)
workbook_sheets_read <- readxl::excel_sheets(table_file)
svg_text <- readLines(figure_file, warn = FALSE)
xlsx_entries <- utils::unzip(table_file, list = TRUE)$Name
xlsx_relationship_entries <- xlsx_entries[grepl("\\.rels$", xlsx_entries)]
xlsx_relationship_text <- unlist(lapply(xlsx_relationship_entries, function(entry) {
  readLines(unz(table_file, entry), warn = FALSE)
}), use.names = FALSE)
dangling_drawing_relationship <- any(grepl(
  "relationships/(drawing|vmlDrawing)", xlsx_relationship_text
))

artifact_audit <- data.frame(
  artifact = c("Result RDA", "Workbook", "SVG figure"),
  exists = c(
    file.exists(result_file), file.exists(table_file), file.exists(figure_file)
  ),
  bytes = c(
    file.info(result_file)$size,
    file.info(table_file)$size,
    file.info(figure_file)$size
  ),
  md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(c(result_file, table_file, figure_file))),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

validation <- data.frame(
  gate = c(
    "Both raw and standardized Mplus models terminated normally",
    "Mplus 8.7 and MLR verified",
    "Common S3.3/S3.4 sample and 209 clusters verified",
    "Engagement Time absent from S3.3 model syntax",
    "Four focal paths per representation parsed",
    "Two direct contrasts per representation parsed",
    "Residual variances positive",
    "R-squared admissible",
    "Raw and standardized signs agree",
    "Multicollinearity thresholds passed",
    "Residual and influence diagnostics finite",
    "Raw-duration context retained for later comparison",
    "Workbook sheets verified",
    "Workbook has no dangling drawing relationships",
    "SVG is vector output",
    "Saved result RDA reloaded"
  ),
  passed = c(
    all(diagnostics$normal_termination),
    all(model_fit$mplus_version == "8.7" & model_fit$estimator == "MLR"),
    all(model_fit$observations == expected_observations &
      model_fit$clusters == expected_clusters),
    all(vapply(model_runs, function(run) run$checks$no_engagement_variables, logical(1))),
    all(diagnostics$required_paths == 4L),
    all(diagnostics$required_contrasts == 2L),
    all(diagnostics$residual_variances_positive),
    all(r_squared$r_squared >= 0 & r_squared$r_squared <= 1),
    all(sign_agreement$sign_agrees),
    max(vif_diagnostics$vif) < 5 &&
      max(condition_diagnostics$condition_index) < 30,
    all(is.finite(residual_diagnostics$rmse)) &&
      all(is.finite(influence_diagnostics$maximum_absolute_change)),
    duration_context$zero_percent[duration_context$variable == "ActiveTime"] > 75 &&
      duration_context$endpoint_300_count[duration_context$variable == "ActiveTime"] == 5L,
    identical(workbook_sheets_read, names(workbook_sheets)),
    !dangling_drawing_relationship,
    any(grepl("<svg", svg_text, fixed = TRUE)) &&
      !any(grepl("<image", svg_text, fixed = TRUE)),
    identical(verified_result$metadata$observations, expected_observations)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
stopifnot(all(artifact_audit$exists), all(validation$passed))

```

S3.4 uses the identical sample for the adjusted-versus-unadjusted coefficient
comparison.
